title: Support
html:
Kamailio is a collaborative open source project, with support offered for free on best effort by its community of developers and users.

The documentation index is available at:

  • https://www.kamailio.org/w/documentation/

The wiki portal maintains a consistent group of tutorials (including installation guidelines) and indexes for configuration file parameters, variables and functions:

  • https://www.kamailio.org/wiki/

To browse the documentation for the modules included in the latest stable version of Kamailio, go to:

  • https://www.kamailio.org/docs/modules/stable/

Asking questions and interacting with the community can be done via mailing lists, matrix or IRC channels, see:

  • mailing lists details
  • matrix chat room: #kamailio:matrix.kamailio.dev
  • irc channels

Reporting issues has to be done via the tracker:

  • https://github.com/kamailio/kamailio/issues

Notes about downloading Kamailio sources or binaries are available at:

  • https://www.kamailio.org/w/download/

Many companies world wide have build products or services world wide and they may offer support under commercial terms. You can find them by searching on the web, a list with a selection is available at:

  • https://www.kamailio.org/w/business-directory/

Thank you for flying Kamailio!
